_tool_scope: This file is an evaluation definition — not executed as agent instructions. Assertions of type llm_judge are grading metadata, not tool grants. The skill uses only read access.

evals.name: live-search-bloc-no-rxdart
evals.prompt: How do I implement live search in Flutter using BLoC without rxdart? I want debounce behavior.

assertions.description: Response must explain and show the debounceRestartable EventTransformer combining _DebounceTransformer with restartable() from bloc_concurrency — no rxdart import anywhere.
Response must provide a concrete SearchBloc code example using on<QueryChangedEvent> with transformer: debounceRestartable(Duration(milliseconds: 300)).
Response must include the _DebounceTransformer implementation or reference it explicitly, and must NOT suggest installing rxdart.

evals.name: event-transformer-double-submit
evals.prompt: What EventTransformer should I use for a form submit button — I want to prevent double-submit?

assertions.description: Response must recommend droppable() from bloc_concurrency and clearly explain that it ignores new events while the current handler is still executing.
Response must include a code snippet showing on<SubmitFormEvent>(_onSubmit, transformer: droppable()) or equivalent.
Response must contrast droppable() against the other transformers (restartable, sequential, concurrent) to justify the choice.

evals.name: combinar-dos-streamproviders-riverpod
evals.prompt: ¿Cómo combino dos StreamProviders de Riverpod para mostrar datos de usuario y sus pedidos al mismo tiempo?

assertions.description: La respuesta debe mostrar composición de providers mediante ref.watch de dos providers distintos (usuario y pedidos) dentro de un único provider derivado o AsyncNotifier.
La respuesta debe demostrar el patrón whenData/flatten o un AsyncNotifier que suscribe a los dos streams con ref.onDispose para limpieza automática.
La respuesta debe estar en español (idioma del prompt) y no debe sugerir rxdart ni combineLatest de rxdart.

evals.name: broadcast-stream-multiple-listeners
evals.prompt: I have a StreamController that I need multiple widgets to listen to. What type should I use?

assertions.description: Response must recommend StreamController.broadcast() and explain that a single-subscription StreamController throws StateError on a second listen.
Response must include a code example showing StreamController<T>.broadcast() and must advise exposing only the .stream getter (never the controller itself).

evals.name: error-handling-without-termination
evals.prompt: How do I handle errors in a Dart stream without the stream terminating?

assertions.description: Response must explain at least two native Dart mechanisms: cancelOnError: false in listen() and stream.handleError().
Response must include concrete code showing both approaches with a comment or explanation of why the stream continues without terminating.
Response must warn against silently swallowing errors and show logging or fallback handling in the examples.

evals.name: scope-boundary-rxdart-switchmap
evals.prompt: How do I add rxdart to my project for switchMap?

assertions.description: Response must actively discourage adding rxdart and explain that the skill's scope excludes it.
Response must provide the native Dart alternative to switchMap: restartable() EventTransformer for BLoC and/or stream.asyncExpand() for raw streams.
Response must include a working code example of the native alternative so the developer has a direct replacement without needing rxdart.
